in_sanskrit.name: Lalita
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Lalita in Sanskrit signifies a playful, delightful, charming, attractive, and graceful being. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'lal' which means 'to play'. The name is used in Hinduism and Jainism to denote a joyful and lively spirit.

in_hindi.name: लालित
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name Lalji is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lalita'. The name Lalita in Hindi means 'delightful, charming, attractive, graceful, and playful'. It is often used to describe someone who is full of joy, vivacious, and lively. The name is also used in Hinduism and Jainism.

in_tamil.name: லலிதா
in_tamil.meaning: லலிதா - காலை விழித்து விளக்கும், அடிக்கையான, ஆகத்தியான
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Lalji is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lalita'. The name Lalita in Tamil means 'one who plays during the night, delightful, charming, and attractive'. It is also used to describe someone who is full of joy, vivacious, and lively. The name is used in Hinduism and Jainism.

in_telugu.name: లలిత
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Lalji is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lalita'. The name Lalita in Telugu means 'one who plays with Lord Shiva, joyful, and playful'. It is also used to describe someone who is full of joy, vivacious, and lively. The name is used in Hinduism and Jainism.

in_marathi.name: Lalji
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lalji हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Lal’, meaning ‘radiant’ or ‘bright’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Lalji is a manifestation of Lord Vishnu, known for his divine radiance and powerful presence.
